# A Bash guard keeps git commit and git push in separate tool calls

## Context

Two Claude seats lost hours to auto-mode classifier refusals of a chained git write on their own feature branch.

- **2026-11-17, Grace, #21283 Round-1 fix:** one Bash call ran `git commit -F -`, then a `git log … | grep -c noreply` attribution check, then `git push … | tail`. The classifier refused the whole call as [Undermining Oversight]. About 2.5 hours later the same commit and push, as two plain calls, went through. Meanwhile Euclid's review sat unanswered while the seat asked the operator for permission every turn.
- **2026-11-17, Ada, #21163:** a push with an output filter (`| grep -vE`) was refused. The plain retry, `git push -u origin ada/21163-bigdata-scale:ada/21163-bigdata-scale`, was refused too. The seat asked the operator and parked the PR.
- **Operator, 2026-11-18:** *"i think it really is just NOT to combine commit and push in one tool call, which can lead to harness refusals."*

Observed: both first refusals were chained calls that pushed, and the separate plain calls passed (Grace). Inferred, not visible: the classifier judges a chained call as one action, and after a refusal a retry on the same target reads as a workaround (Ada's second refusal). The classifier's internals are unknown.

## The Problem

`pull-request-workflow.md` §3.3 shows commit and push as separate steps, but nothing stops a seat from chaining them. The first refusal is enough to stall a lane: a review response waits, or a push waits on an operator ask that is not his to give.

## The Architectural Reality

- Claude Code `PreToolUse` Bash guards live in `.claude/hooks/` and are registered in `.claude/settings.template.json` (`PreToolUse` → `matcher: "Bash"`: `rgReplaceGuardHook`, `bodyFileGuardHook`, `redirectionGuardHook`).
- The shell tokenizer they share is `tokenizeShellCommand` (`.claude/hooks/rgReplaceGuardHook.mjs`). `redirectionGuardHook` respects quotes, comments and heredoc bodies, and scans command substitutions as commands.
- Each guard has a unit spec in `test/playwright/unit/hooks/`, and each fails open on a malformed payload.
- Classifier policy is out of reach from the project: its `autoMode` block is never read (#20796).
- Design authority: n/a — adds a guard.

## The Fix

`.claude/hooks/gitCommitPushGuardHook.mjs`, a sibling of `redirectionGuardHook`: it denies a Bash command in which `git commit` and `git push` both run, in any order, chained by `&&`, `||`, `;`, `|` or newlines, command substitutions included. Its message says to run them as two plain calls, and that a refused push to one's own branch is split and retried, not taken to the operator. It is registered in `.claude/settings.template.json` beside its siblings.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A call running both `git commit` and `git push` is denied with the message, in each chaining form; either one alone passes; `cd <dir> && git push …`, `git -C <dir> push …` and a push piped into `tail` pass (unit).
- [ ] Quoted text, heredoc bodies and comments never count: a commit message that mentions `git push` passes (unit).
- [ ] A malformed payload passes (fail open), and the guard is registered in `.claude/settings.template.json` (unit reads the template).
- [ ] Receipts at the PR head: the hook's unit spec and `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/hooks`.

## Out of Scope

- Classifier policy and allow rules (#20796).
- A plain single push that is refused: on one's own branch, report it once and keep the lane moving.
